description:
Free open-source YouTube downloader GUI based on yt-dlp for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Download videos, Shorts, 4K, 1080p60, HDR, and subtitles with no ads, tracking, cookies, or login. Supports 9 languages.

Arroxy is a free, open-source desktop app for downloading YouTube videos and Shorts in up to 4K, 1080p60, HDR, and audio-only formats with no ads, tracking, or login required.
Install
Windows Setup Windows Portable
macOS Apple Silicon macOS Intel
Linux AppImage Linux Flatpak Linux tar.gz
SHA256
Arroxy is a much smaller app, with a round of security fixes to the code it ships.
Highlights
A Much Smaller App
- Arroxy's own files shrank from about 140 MB to 11 MB. Earlier builds carried thousands of files the app never used, including a whole developer tool, alongside the code that actually runs. Installed on a Mac, the app now takes about 70 MB less space, and downloads and updates are smaller too.
- Nothing changes in how Arroxy looks or works. The parts that run are exactly the same as before.
Security Fixes
- The bundled YAML and URL parsing libraries are updated to versions with upstream security fixes.
- Removing the unused files also removed several third-party packages with known security advisories from the app entirely.
What's Changed
- build(deps-dev): bump vitest from 4.1.10 to 4.1.11 in /packages/ytdlp-errors by @dependabot[bot] in #214
- fix(deps): stop shipping the shadcn tree and make the vulnerability gate meaningful by @antonio-orionus in #240
- build: ship no node_modules in the packaged app by @antonio-orionus in #241
Full Changelog: v0.4.18...v0.4.19
